hookups.source: City page: 'All hard pad sites, #1-13, and long term sites 15-22, have water, sewer and 30 and 50 Amp electric hookups'; park map: 'Blacktop camper pads #1 - 14 have electric, water, sewer and picnic tables', read 2026-11-11

values.note: Blacktop pads 1-14 (full hookups) and gravel pads 15-22, plus a separate tent area. The city's page calls 15-22 'long term sites' with full hookups; its park map says they are 'electric only, and available on a first come first serve basis'.

sites.source: City page + park map (pads numbered 1-22, tent sites drawn apart), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Closing date depends on the weather; water and sewer are shut off once nights drop below freezing. After October 1 camping is first come only.

season.source: City page: 'Ambush Park is open May 1 - October 31. We do not take reservations after October 1 of each year. Camping after October 1 is on a first come first served basis. Closing the park for the season is weather dependent.'; 'Water and sewer hookups will not be available at the park once temperatures drop below freezing at night', read 2026-11-11

values.note: Booked online on the city's ResNexus engine, paid in full plus a non-refundable reservation fee. A camper without a reservation may take a site the caretaker confirms is free and pay by envelope at the registration board. Check-in noon, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: City page: 'Reservations for camping and shelters can be made by clicking here for our online reservation system'; 'Reservations are taken for camping dates between May 1 and September 30'; 'Reservations can be made up to one year in advance'; 'Campers who pull into a site without a reservation and have verified with the caretaker that the site is available ... can pay using the payment envelopes'; park map: pads 15-22 'available on a first come first serve basis', read 2026-11-11

note: City of Benson campground in Ambush Park at the west edge of town, with mini golf, disc golf, a playground, river access and nature trails. The Chippewa River runs past the far side of the park loop, about 100 m and a band of trees from the RV pads. A separate tent area. --Claude
summary: City page + 2026 park map read: 22 RV pads (1-14 blacktop full hookups 30/50 A; 15-22 gravel, page says full hookups, map says electric only + first come), season May 1-Oct 31, reservations May 1-Sep 30 on ResNexus up to a year out, walk-ups by envelope. Count 17 -> 22. Rates: only a 2023 sheet ($40 incl. tax with the $5 reservation fee, $35 walk-up) - not written; ResNexus unread (Incapsula). WATERFRONT: riverfront -> not waterfront recommended. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade, riverfront -> not waterfront): the 2026 park map puts blacktop pads 1-14 on the WEST road of the park loop and gravel pads 15-22 in a lot by Highway 9; the Chippewa River runs past the EAST side of the loop. On imagery the pads (RVs at ~45.3211,-95.6189) are ~100 m from the river with the east loop road, the registration/parking area and a continuous riverbank tree band between; gravel pads 15-22 (~45.3209,-95.6205) are ~200 m away. No site is within ~50 m over open ground, and no evidence of a view was found.

Rates: the city's only posted rate sheet is 'Revised 5/1/2023' (hard pads $40 a night including lodging and sales tax and the $5 reservation fee; $35 without a reservation; weekly $215). Older than 2024, so no fees written; the ResNexus engine (where current prices would show) returned an Incapsula bot challenge and was not retried.

Long-stay: the page calls pads 15-22 'long term sites' and the 2023 sheet posts weekly rates, but the 14 blacktop pads are sold by the night online and the map says 15-22 are first come; not seasonal in character.
Facilities: the page and map do not mention showers or a dump station (the map shows restroom icons); stored derived showers/dump left as they are.
Pin 45.32116,-95.61779 is ~90 m east of the blacktop pads, inside the park loop: OK.
Phone 320-843-4775 (City Hall, printed on the rate sheet and the page): confirmed. Campground email camping@bensonmn.us.
Note: 'on the Chippewa River', the street address and the facility/booking facts dropped (fields hold them; river placement corrected).
